assertions.name: reproduces_cds1_F_table_on_the_retired_base
assertions.source: the three phase cells reproduce bean qou-cds1's recorded -0.076 % / -35.9 % / -3.17 % to better than 0.005 absolute, so the machinery below is the bean's own and not a re-invention. Note the coordinate: these are relative deviations of (1 - F), not of F.

assertions.name: every_ruled_base_needs_F_above_one
assertions.source: F_required = 1.759236994 on the z_D order-zero base and 1.200162364 on the dashboard's scored cell — both ABOVE 1 — against 0.9983252417 on the retired z = 1 cell, which is below. The sign of (1 - F_required) flips with the base.

assertions.name: ladder_form_is_bounded_by_one_for_every_phase
assertions.source: F_N2(alpha) = cos(alpha - u/2)*(1 - u^2), and cos <= 1 (Real.cos_le_one — the same proved invariant the eigenphase carrier's own replacement_excludes_some_matrix uses), so sup over ALL real alpha is attained at alpha = u/2 and equals 1 - u^2 = 0.9999274567156176265. Every ruled base needs more than 1. **No phase closes it** — so deriving alpha cannot unblock the ladder on the ruled base, and qou-cds1's 'the blocker is still the N=1 phase' does not hold for the base the same entry adopts.

assertions.name: closing_inside_the_ladder_needs_c2_four_orders_from_structural
assertions.source: if the shortfall were pushed into the rungs instead, the leading coefficient would have to be c_2 ~ 10467.745 on the z_D base and 2760.4131 on the dashboard cell, against the structural c_2 = -1 — four orders of magnitude, and the wrong sign. The magnifier 1/u^2 = 13784.874 is why c_k is the wrong coordinate to read this in (qou-cds1's own finding).

assertions.name: the_reldev_coordinate_is_meaningless_once_F_required_exceeds_one
assertions.source: on the ruled base 1 - F_required = -0.75923699 is NEGATIVE while the model's 1 - F_N2 = 0.0016216579 stays positive, so qou-cds1's reldev coordinate returns -100.21359 % — a ratio of opposite-signed quantities, meaningless rather than merely large. Report F directly on a ruled base; the reldev table is retired-base-only.

assertions.name: every_recorded_rung_reduces_so_no_truncation_order_helps
assertions.source: the objection check 3 invites is 'a higher rung saves it'. It does not: every c_k the corpus records or derives is NEGATIVE — c_2 = -1 (structural), c_3 = -2.0693425728 (recorded proton extraction), c_5 = -(b^2 + 1/2) = -1.25270211325 (derived) — so each factor (1 + c_k u^k) < 1 and the product is 0.99992617817132 < 1. With cos <= 1 the whole F is strictly below 1 at EVERY truncation order, not merely at N=2. Reaching F > 1 needs a POSITIVE coefficient, and none of the derived ones is.

assertions.name: the_target_is_stated_as_a_magnitude_not_as_a_search
assertions.source: stated so the size is on the record, NOT as a specification to search against: at the order-zero E_0 the ruled functional gives |eps| = 0.106235639848, and reproducing CODATA would need 0.186893667722 — a factor 1.759236994. Per AGENTS.md NO FITTING a target may be checked AGAINST, never searched ON: do not hunt for an element whose Markov trace lands here. The dashboard's own scored element already fails the confinement-SDP selection rule (owner ruling 2026-09-13), so the assembly is under review independently of this number.

description: On the owner-ruled Q_beta base the ladder's correction factor F_N2(alpha) = cos(alpha - u/2)(1 - u^2) is bounded above by 1 - u^2 for EVERY real alpha (cos <= 1), while F_required = Q_codata/Q_base EXCEEDS 1 on both ruled cells (1.7594 at z_D order-zero E_0, 1.2002 on the dashboard's scored nuc11 cell) and is BELOW 1 only on the retired z = 1 cell (0.9983). So no phase closes the ladder on the ruled base, and qou-cds1's standing blocker — 'the blocker is still the N=1 phase (qou-pdix)' — does not hold for the base that same entry adopts. Calibrated first by reproducing qou-cds1's own F-table (-0.076 / -35.9 / -3.17 %) on the retired base. Does not retire alpha as a question, does not refute the ladder or the forced bar-odd projection (both C-frame, untouched), and does not choose a base: F_required < 1 on the retired cell is NOT a reason to prefer it (NO FITTING).
full_ladder_is_reducing: every c_k the corpus records or derives is NEGATIVE (c_2 = -1 structural, c_3 = -2.0693425728 recorded, c_5 = -(b^2+1/2) derived), so each factor (1 + c_k u^k) < 1 and F is strictly below 1 at EVERY truncation order -- not merely at the N=2 one check 3 bounds. Reaching F > 1 needs a POSITIVE coefficient; none of the derived ones is.
coordinate_warning: qou-cds1's table reports relative deviation of (1 - F), not of F. Once F_required > 1 that ratio compares opposite-signed quantities and is meaningless; report F directly on a ruled base.
scope: (b) for the exclusion, citing a proved invariant; (a) for every number. Derives no alpha, selects no base, wires nothing.
